description: Baseline network security requirements enforced alongside the Terraform security groups and NACLs.

requirements.rule: Security groups must not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 except to ports 80/443 on public load balancers.
requirements.title: No unrestricted ingress

requirements.rule: Ports 22 and 3389 must never be open to 0.0.0.0/0. Administrative access uses SSM Session Manager.
requirements.title: No unrestricted SSH/RDP

requirements.rule: Workloads use explicit egress rules; default-allow-all egress must be justified and time-boxed.
requirements.title: Default deny egress posture documented

requirements.rule: VPC Flow Logs must be enabled for all VPCs and delivered to the centralized security logs bucket.
requirements.title: VPC flow logs enabled

requirements.rule: All service-to-service and client traffic must use TLS 1.2 or higher.
requirements.title: TLS everywhere
